CONDITIONAL: QA1 AUDIT, SPRINT 1, commit 9427918. VERDICT: CONDITIONAL (one demonstrated defect, one required fix, rest met).

Sprint file re-read fresh before verdict; unchanged since start (clean tree). No between-versions criterion in this sprint.

REQUIRED FIX 1 (demonstrated) - Req 2 "Every design token reaches the browser" is NOT met. app/tokens.css uses @theme inline. Tailwind 4 tree-shakes unused theme variables out of the emitted CSS. Ran the real @tailwindcss/postcss plugin (with source scanning, same as next build) over app/globals.css at this commit: 12 of 24 token custom properties are absent from the output - all 7 shape/padding/shadow/border tokens (radius-input, radius-button, padding-input-x, padding-input-y, shadow-xs, shadow-sm, border-width) and 5 of 7 type tokens (type-button, type-link, type-caption, type-legal, type-error). The 10 colours only survive by accident: the literal names appear in docs/design/design-tokens.md, which the scanner happens to read (git grep shows that file and tokens.css are the only hits). Without that doc text, an in-memory compile emitted only bg-base and text-default. The drift test reads the source stylesheet, not built CSS, so it cannot catch this. Verified fix in memory: changing the block to @theme static inline emits all 24. Dev Team: apply that (or equivalent) and add a test that asserts every token is present in compiled CSS, not just in tokens.css.

REQUIRED FIX 2 - Req 8: "the secret key is readable only by server code: its module fails to import into client code". process.env.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY is read in lib/env.ts, which has no server-only guard and is imported by lib/supabase/browser.ts. Only admin.ts is guarded. No leak today (nothing client-side imports browser.ts yet, and Next never inlines non-public values), but sprint 2 will import browser.ts from client code and the variable name can land in a client bundle, which is exactly what LiveQA AC8 searches for. Move getSupabaseSecretKey into a server-only module.

MET: AC1 Next 16.3.5, React 19.3.0, TS strict, engines 24.x, eslint/tsconfig/vitest exclude framework dirs, no diff under scripts/.claude/templates/docs/sprints. AC2 values match design-tokens.md line by line incl type-error 400 11px/100%; bg-bg-base used on Splash (see fix 1 for emission). AC3 no-literal-colors test reads correctly and runs in CI via npm test. AC4 drift test parses the md, guards against vacuous pass. AC6 docs/public gone, 34 files at same paths. AC8 admin client imports server-only, no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, .env.example lists the 4 vars empty, git grep finds no sb_secret/sb_publishable/JWT keys. AC9 exactly one migration, revoke from public and from anon/authenticated/service_role, grant to anon only; CLAUDE.md procedure present. AC10 route test covers error, unexpected value and throw branches with exact body. AC11 ci.yml on push + pull_request, lint/typecheck/test/build, supabase start before tests. AC14 ran npm run db:start then npm run db:reset locally: migration applied from scratch; anon rpc health_check returned true HTTP 200, service_role got 42501 HTTP 403. Stack stopped afterward. npm test 46 passed 1 skipped (db test skips without env; runs in CI), lint and typecheck clean.

NON-BLOCKING: (a) health_check is anon-only by spec, but the route uses the cookie-scoped server client; once sprint 2 adds sessions, a signed-in caller becomes authenticated and /api/health will 503 for them - MC should decide before sprint 2. (b) no-literal-colors scans only app/ and lib/; a future components/ dir would be unscanned. (c) CI uses supabase/setup-cli version latest while package.json pins supabase 2.117.0 - pin CI to match. (d) the local db test silently skips without env; acceptable since CI sets it.

PASS: QA1 RE-AUDIT, SPRINT 1, ROUND 2, commit f3b1505 (tree clean). VERDICT: PASS.

Sprint file re-read fresh before verdict. It has not changed since round 1: git diff 9427918..f3b1505 under docs/sprints touches only state/sprint-1.json. No criterion here claims something arrives between two versions. Review focused on the fix commit (8 files).

ROUND 1 FIX 1 (Req 2, tokens tree-shaken): FIXED, demonstrated. app/tokens.css now uses @theme static inline. Ran the real @tailwindcss/postcss plugin in memory over app/globals.css, swapping the actual at-rule line back to @theme inline. It still drops 12 required tokens (7 shape/padding/shadow/border, plus type-button, type-link, type-caption, type-legal, type-error) and also font-display. With HEAD static inline: 0 of 26 missing, both with full scanning and with source(none). Colours no longer depend on doc text being scanned. The new tests/tokens-compiled.test.ts asserts all 24 tokens in compiled output, so it would fail on that regression. It is not vacuous: the result is the same with the test file excluded from scanning. Production check: npm run build, then all 26 custom properties present in the one emitted .next/static CSS file.

(Note for the record: my first falsification attempt was invalid. A plain string replace matched the phrase @theme static inline inside the tokens.css comment, not the at-rule. I redid it anchored on the at-rule line. The numbers above are from the corrected run.)

ROUND 1 FIX 2 (Req 8, secret key reachable from client-imported module): FIXED. getSupabaseSecretKey moved to lib/env.server.ts, which imports server-only. lib/env.ts (imported by browser.ts) no longer reads SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY. The only consumer is lib/supabase/admin.ts, which is also server-only. git grep confirms no other reader. The shared required() helper is exported and reused, not duplicated. tests/env-server.test.ts checks three things: the real guard throws under jsdom; the missing-var message; and the return value, with server-only stubbed. Built client JS (10 files in .next/static) contains neither SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY nor sb_secret.

ALSO FIXED: CI supabase/setup-cli pinned to 2.117.0, matching package.json (round 1 non-blocking c).

VERIFIED THIS ROUND: npm test 52 passed, 1 skipped (DB integration test skips without local env, runs in CI). npm run lint clean, npm run typecheck clean, npm run build clean (Next 16.3.5). Tree clean after build. Every round 1 MET item stands: the changed files do not touch the migration, route, assets, CI triggers or drift/no-literal-colour tests.

STILL OPEN, NON-BLOCKING, for Master Controller: (a) health_check is granted to anon only, but the route uses the cookie-scoped server client, so after sprint 2 adds sessions a signed-in caller of /api/health will get 503. Decide before sprint 2. (b) the no-literal-colors check scans only app/ and lib/; a future components/ dir would go unchecked. (d) the DB integration test silently skips locally without env; acceptable since CI sets it.

Live-test items (Req 5, 7, 9 prod apply, 10 live, 12, 13) are LiveQA scope and not asserted here.

Not verified by LiveQA. I did not open the Vercel dashboard or runtime logs, and I read no values.
2. [Required] AC12: CLAUDE.md line 559 still reads "Production URL: _to be recorded here by Pipeman after the first deploy". Req 12 requires the production URL in CLAUDE.md project standards. Commit b6da2ed does not include it.

CHECKS THAT PASSED (partial, for the record)

- AC8 (name-level): all 7 JS chunks referenced from / downloaded. 0 files contain SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY, 0 contain sb_secret_, 0 contain service_role. Key-value prefix search not done (LiveQA holds no key value, by design).
- AC5 (partial, from HTML only): fonts preload from /_next/static/immutable/media/*.woff2 (self-hosted). No fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com reference in the HTML. Browser network panel check not yet done.
- AC7 (partial, from HTML only): / renders main.bg-bg-base with a single img of /brand/show-off-logo.svg, alt "Show Off", and no visible text nodes. Visual check at 320/375/desktop, console errors and Figma comparison not yet done.

AC2 computed colour tokens in the browser; AC5 network panel; AC7 visual at 3 widths plus console; AC9 integration dashboard; AC11 GitHub Actions run for the deployed commit; AC12 Vercel production deployment shows the deployed commit; AC13 auth settings mailer_autoconfirm plus empty auth user list.

1. [Blocker] AC13 / D-03 no-email rule: Supabase "Confirm email" is ON in production. GET https://htlzzbfrefsgyiyanoiv.supabase.co/auth/v1/settings with the project's publishable key (public by design) returned "mailer_autoconfirm":false. Checked 3 times (15:42 UTC), all false. Same response: disable_signup false, external.email true. Req 13 and CLAUDE.md require this setting off so that creating an account never sends mail. As things stand, the first signup (sprint 2 onward, including LiveQA's own example.com test accounts) would make Supabase send a confirmation email. This is operator dashboard config (Authentication, Sign In / Providers, Email, Confirm email), not code, the same shape as D-58. Req 13's flagged assumption holds: the endpoint does report the setting. What it reports is the wrong value. No account was created, and no email-sending action was taken.

- AC10 PASS: GET /api/health returned HTTP 200, body exactly {"ok":true,"database":true}. 3 of 3 runs, 15:41 UTC. Headers: content-type application/json, x-vercel-cache MISS. This observes the migration reaching production and the route calling it, per D-58's fix.
- AC12 PASS: CLAUDE.md at 9924cb6, line 559, reads "Production URL: https://show-off-test.vercel.app". Vercel get_deployment on show-off-test.vercel.app: id dpl_6o38yUHRSEY4FcrkBEdtHrBqQ3vx, target production, readyState READY, source git, githubCommitRef main, githubCommitSha 8411871dc1a38d8b14c207036f4a1ed5799489f4. Integration dashboard page (applied from the deployed commit) and Branching off not yet viewed in the browser.

origin/main history carries 268a066 "Start sprint 1" immediately reverted by 55557bc, both touching only the sprint-1 state file. Net zero, noted for the record only.

CONDITIONAL: LiveQA round 3, sprint 1. Verdict CONDITIONAL. FINDINGS
1. [Medium, visual; AC7 Figma comparison] The Splash logo renders about 34-37 percent larger than the Figma Splash frame.
   Figma (file pKPcNRMWgms1Y6L80jdGNV, page Game UI, frame Splash 375x667, logo layer Group 91 = OFF + SHOW, read from the Properties panel): W 173.45px, H 125.74px, left 101, top 271, so the centre is (187.7, 333.9).
   Production, / loaded in a 375x667 same-origin iframe: img box 262.5x233.1 at (56.3, 217). The SVG is 375x333 natural, and its visible logo pixels span svg (23,35)-(354,281). Rendered logo ink is about 232x172 CSS px, centred at (188, 328).
   Ratio 232/173.45 = 1.34 wide, 172/125.74 = 1.37 tall. Figma's group bounds include the text boxes, so the real difference is at least this large.
   Other widths, same iframe method, image box: 320px wide gives 224x198.9; 1400px desktop window gives 320x284 (capped).
   Position matches (centre within 6px). Background colour differs from Figma's 0F0E0C by design (req 7).
   Fix: size the logo to match the frame (about 173px wide at 375), or have Master Controller record a decision that the current size is accepted.
2. [Outstanding, not a defect; AC9] Supabase GitHub integration dashboard page not viewed. The connected Chrome is signed out of Supabase: the integrations URL redirected to supabase.com/dashboard/sign-in. LiveQA does not sign in. Per AC9, the operator shares a screenshot of the integration page showing the baseline migration applied from the deployed commit on main, with Branching off.
   Indirect evidence gathered: list_migrations shows exactly 1 migration, 20260913000000 health_check. list_branches returns only the default branch record: name main, git_branch main, is_default true, persistent false, project_ref htlzzbfrefsgyiyanoiv, which is the production project itself. No preview branches exist.

VERIFIED THIS ROUND
- AC13 PASS: auth/v1/settings on the production project returned mailer_autoconfirm true, 3 of 3 at 15:47 UTC and again at 15:53 UTC. auth.users count 0 at start (15:47) and after the whole live test (15:53:43 UTC). No account was created and no email-sending action was taken.
- AC10 still PASS: /api/health returned 200 {"ok":true,"database":true} at 15:47 (2 of 2) and at 15:53.
- AC2 PASS, with a note: getComputedStyle(documentElement) on production returns all 10 colour tokens with the right names and values, in the minified form the build ships:
  --color-bg-base #000, --color-bg-surface #0a0a0a, --color-border-default #404040, --color-accent #b4ff00, --color-text-default #fafafa, --color-text-emphasis #fff, --color-text-subtle #a3a3a3, --color-text-secondary #9a9590, --color-error #ff6467, --color-error-text #fdbdbe.
  Each is the same colour as design-tokens.md, and the served CSS 24jwm__ih5wm7.css carries these exact strings. The string form differs from the design file only by lowercase and short hex (#000 for #000000, #fff for #FFFFFF), which is build minification. Master Controller may want to confirm that "exactly" in AC2 means same value rather than same string.
  main computed background is rgb(0, 0, 0). Type tokens are also served, e.g. --type-error is 400 11px/100% var(--font-body), and --font-body is var(--font-space-grotesk).

  The splash has no text, so no font loads on its own. A temporary probe element (removed after) using var(--font-display) and var(--font-body) at 400 and 500 gave computed families "Bebas Neue", "Bebas Neue Fallback" and "Space Grotesk", "Space Grotesk Fallback". document.fonts reports loaded: Bebas Neue 400, Space Grotesk 400, Space Grotesk 500. fonts.check is true for all three, and all font resources are the same 2 same-origin woff2 files. Body computed font-family is "Space Grotesk", "Space Grotesk Fallback".

  375: 375/375, gaps 56/56 and 203/203.

  Chrome cannot size a real window below a 500px viewport, which is why the iframe method was used.
- AC11 PASS: GitHub API shows the CI workflow run 34766273381 for 9924cb6 (event push, branch main, completed, success) and run 34766288170 for 8411871 (success).
  Steps, all success: Set up job, checkout, setup-node, Install dependencies, Lint, Type check, supabase/setup-cli, Start local Supabase and apply migrations, Export local Supabase connection details for tests, Test (Vitest, jsdom, incl. database tests against the local stack), Build.

Log body text shows "Sign in to view logs" (browser signed out of GitHub), so the step's log lines were not read. Step name and status are visible.

TO RESOLVE

Tools: curl (Bash); Claude in Chrome (macOS): same-origin iframes at exact sizes plus a 1400x733 desktop window; Vercel MCP and Supabase MCP (read-only); GitHub public REST API.

CONFIRMED DEFECT
1. [Required; AC7 per D-60] The logo is not a fixed size and misses D-60's lettering-box height at 375.
   Served markup: img class "h-auto w-[52.4%] max-w-60". This is a percentage of viewport width capped at 240px, so the logo scales with the viewport. D-60 says it is a fixed size, the same at 320px and on desktop.
   Method: getBBox over all 7 path elements of the served /brand/show-off-logo.svg (drop-shadow filters excluded) gives lettering geometry in SVG units x 23.61-354.78, y 35-281.82, so 331.17 x 246.82 in the 375x333 canvas. Multiplied by rendered img width / 375, measured in-page. Consistent with round 3's pixel scan of the same asset: ink (23,35)-(354,281).
   320x667 iframe: img 167.68x148.9 at (76.16, 259.05); lettering 148.08 x 110.36 (target 173.45 x 125.74, off by -25.37 x -15.38). Gaps L 86.72 / R 85.21, T 274.70 / B 281.94.
   375x667 iframe: img 196.5x174.48 at (89.25, 246.26); lettering 173.53 x 129.33. Width within 2px (+0.08). Height outside 2px (+3.59). Gaps L 101.62 / R 99.85 (1.8px apart), T 264.60 / B 273.07. Lettering centre y 329.26 against viewport centre 333.5, so 4.24px high: the img box is centred, but the SVG canvas carries more shadow margin below the letters. Figma's Group 91 top is 271; production's lettering top is 264.6.
   1280x800 iframe: img 240x213.12; lettering 211.95 x 157.96 (+38.50 x +32.22).
   1400x733 desktop window: img 240x213.12 at (580, 259.94); lettering 211.95 x 157.96.
   Note for Master Controller: the SVG's lettering aspect ratio is 331.17/246.82 = 1.342, and Figma's Group 91 is 173.45/125.74 = 1.379. At a uniform scale, this asset can't hit both dimensions within 2px (at w=173.45, h=129.27). Figma's group box likely measures text-layer boxes, while the exported SVG holds outlined glyphs. D-60's height target may need restating (e.g. width-only, or a height derived from this asset) before the next fix.

NO REGRESSION (re-verified)
- AC10: /api/health 200 {"ok":true,"database":true}, 3 of 3 at 16:13:45 UTC.
- AC13: auth/v1/settings "mailer_autoconfirm":true, 3 of 3 at 16:13 UTC; auth.users count 0 at 16:13:51 UTC. No account created, no email-sending action.

- AC11: no CI run exists for 539c36d itself (pushed together with its child). Run 34767684127 for 48d0a8d (contains 539c36d): event push, completed, success.
- AC2, AC6, AC8, AC12: files changed 9924cb6 to 539c36d are app/page.tsx, tests/splash-page.test.tsx and docs only (git diff --stat). Nothing touching tokens, assets, route handlers or env. Round 3 results stand; AC12 deployment re-confirmed above.

PROCESS FLAG (for Master Controller and QA1)
539c36d changes app/page.tsx and tests/splash-page.test.tsx after QA1's last PASS (f3b1505 tree). The state history shows no QA1 audit of it. /sprint-reship recorded it without one, and the operator said QA1 has not seen it. Application code is now live in production with no static audit on record. A QA1 audit of the next fix commit is recommended before reship.

Master Controller: confirm or restate D-60's size target given the aspect-ratio note. Dev Team: make the logo a fixed size meeting that target at every width, with the lettering box centred. QA1: audit the fix. Pipeman: reship. Operator: re-send the AC9 screenshot.
